title: Young Blonde Boy Seated on Theme Park Ride, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid vintage square black-and-white snapshot showing a young blonde boy sitting attentively next to an adult woman, likely his mother, on an amusement park ride or tram in the 1960s. The boy is neatly dressed in a light-colored button-up shirt and shorts, looking off-camera with a curious expression while the woman holds ride tickets.
